newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kong Tai 1996 net loss HK$21.39 mln.
newsitem.headline: Kong Tai 1996 net loss HK$21.39 mln.

text.p: Company name Kong Tai International Holdings Co Ltd
NOTE - Kong Tai International is a property concern, formerly Golden Hill Land Development Co Ltd.

The company changed its financial year-end to December 31 from March 31. Comparative figures are for nine months ended December 31, 1995, and adjusted for overstatement of loan and other receivables and overstatement of the value of investment properties.

Net is after an exceptional gain of HK$29.99 million on sale of subsidiaries, gain of HK$30.5 million on revaluation of properties under redevelopment, loss of HK$24.71 million on sale of listed investments and loss of HK$1.47 million on revaluation of investment properties.
Loss per share is based on the weighted average of 784.95 million shares vs 719.47 million.
Total dividend for year is nil vs nil (nine months).
